documents.title: Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI LODR
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Vadilal Industries reported a 3% growth in consolidated revenues for FY19, which adjusted to 13% when accounting for changes in domestic billing methodology. The company's international business grew by 54% during the year, crossing the $20 million milestone. For FY20, Vadilal expects to deliver double-digit growth and plans to spend Rs. 30-35 crore on capital expenditure. Additionally, the company is focusing on debt rationalization and expanding its retail footprint with 10,000 new sales outlets planned.

guidance.claim: The company expects to deliver double-digit growth with higher contribution from international business leading to margin expansion.
guidance.quote: We also expect to deliver double digit growth with higher contribution from international business leading to margin expansion.

guidance.claim: The company plans to look into increasing prices in the second half of the year due to higher milk prices.
guidance.quote: As milk prices are at higher levels now, we will look to increasing prices in the second half of the year.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic business experienced weakness in Q4 due to exceptionally severe weather conditions that extended winter and impacted ice cream consumption.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic business saw weakness in Q4 due to exceptionally severe weather conditions that extended the winter till the end of March this year and impacted the consumption of ice cream in many of our core markets.

demand_outlook.claim: International business growth is driven by strong demand for high-quality ice creams and other products within the Indian diaspora community.
demand_outlook.quote: International business is now over 25% of revenues and growth is driven by strong demand for our high quality ice creams and other products within the sizeable Indian diaspora community in the U.S. and some other geographies.

demand_outlook.claim: The company started FY20 with double-digit growth in the summer season and 25% revenue expansion in the international business.
demand_outlook.quote: We have started FY20 with double digit growth in the summer season and 25% revenue expansion in international business.

demand_outlook.claim: Latent demand for quality Indian products is driving strong volume growth in US ice cream sales.
demand_outlook.quote: Latent demand for quality Indian products driving strong volume growth in US ice cream sales

capex_expansion.claim: The company expects to spend Rs. 30-35 crore on regular capital expenditure during the year.
capex_expansion.quote: We continue to incur regular capital expenditure and expect to spend Rs. 30-35 crore during the year.

capex_expansion.claim: Estimated capex for FY20 is approximately Rs. 30 crore.
capex_expansion.quote: Estimated capex for FY 20 at ~ Rs. 30 crore

capex_expansion.claim: The company has committed distribution investments in multiple locations in the U.S.
capex_expansion.quote: We have already committed distribution investments in multiple locations in the U.S. that allow us widespread access to the sizeable Indian diaspora in key target markets.

capex_expansion.claim: No major capital expenditure is anticipated on capacity enhancement.
capex_expansion.quote: No major capital expenditure anticipated on capacity enhancement

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin expanded by over 600 basis points last year due to volume growth, benign raw material prices, and larger international contribution.
margins_costs.quote: Gross margin expanded by over 600 basis points last year on the back of volume growth, benign raw material prices and larger contribution from international operations, where realizations are significantly higher.

margins_costs.claim: Cost of people resources increased significantly last year, largely contributed by U.S. operations.
margins_costs.quote: Cost of people resources increased significantly last year, with a large contribution from U.S. operations that now have a base of over 50 employees.

margins_costs.claim: Tight control on other operating expenses kept them almost unchanged.
margins_costs.quote: However, we have kept a tight control on other operating expenses that remained almost unchanged.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin increased by almost 400 basis points and profit after tax more than doubled.
margins_costs.quote: As a result, EBITDA margin increased by almost 400 basis points and profit after tax more than doubled.

margins_costs.claim: The company has visibility of stable costs covered till Q2 based on raw material purchase and inventory position.
margins_costs.quote: Based on our raw material purchase and inventory position, we have visibility of stable costs covered till Q2.

orders_capacity.claim: Production capacity expanded from 270,000 liters per day to 380,000 liters per day over the past few years.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity expanded from 270,000 liters per day to 380,000 liters per day over the past few years

capital_allocation.claim: The company continues to focus on the rationalization of debt.
capital_allocation.quote: Continue to focus on rationalization of debt:

capital_allocation.claim: Outstanding debt was reconstituted to increase long tenure loans and reduce the cost of debt.
capital_allocation.quote: Reconstituted outstanding debt to increase long tenure loans and reduced cost of debt

capital_allocation.claim: The company plans to leverage surplus generated by operations to rationalize/restructure debt and improve working capital management.
capital_allocation.quote: Leveraging surplus generated by operations to rationalize/ restructure debt and improve working capital management

risks_headwinds.claim: Exceptionally severe weather conditions extended winter and impacted ice cream consumption in core markets.
risks_headwinds.quote: Domestic business saw weakness in Q4 due to exceptionally severe weather conditions that extended the winter till the end of March this year and impacted the consumption of ice cream in many of our core markets.

risks_headwinds.claim: Milk prices are currently at higher levels.
risks_headwinds.quote: As milk prices are at higher levels now, we will look to increasing prices in the second half of the year.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to spend Rs. 30-35 crore on regular capital expenditure during the year.
management_commitments.quote: We continue to incur regular capital expenditure and expect to spend Rs. 30-35 crore during the year.
